items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I've got a boy with me right now named Edd Battles

ctx.x: And the same thing usually, if you'll notice, in Roy's earlier records I'd always tell him to -- when he'd get ready to play a chorus, if it didn't interfere with the man playing in front of him, or if it was an ensemble and then his chorus was next, to get him a start coming in, and he'd always do that, you know. He'd bring himself into this chorus before the first bar, and then he'd be in there. He says, 'Man, this gives me a lift. This gives me, This thing, you see. He never forgot that, and he gave me credit…

And I had heard Hawk and the other guys do these things, and I tried to pass this knowledge on to the other guys, you know, and it worked out real well. But now we're going to get back into my group again. I have other guys to talk about. I've had several vocalists in my group at different times, but I've got a boy with me right now named Edd Battles, and he's out of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. And I would say Edd was pretty close to 40 years of age, but this guy is uncanny. He has an excellent vibrato. He sings…
And the thing that knocks me out, though, he -- for his age, he knows the lyrics to all of the old tunes, the standards.
